# env

Modular development environment setup scripts for macOS.

## Metadata
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mustafaabbas1/env
- **Main Entry Point**: `setup.sh`
- **Config Files**: `AGENTS.md` (Agent instructions)

## Project Structure
- `setup.sh`: Root orchestration script.
- `tools/`: Individual tool setup scripts (homebrew, nvm, pyenv, etc.).
- `changelog/`: History of changes.

## Development Context
See `AGENTS.md` for detailed instructions on the modular setup flow and development guidelines.
